prompt: Summarize what was decided in the following meeting notes, in 2-3 sentences for the project record.
input_text: In the kickoff meeting for Northwind Logistics, a three-phase rollout was established, beginning with a discovery phase in April, followed by a pilot at the Hai Phong depot in early May, and a decision gate before broader deployment. Key requirements include an on-premise connector for the warehouse management system, a budget of up to $50,000 pending finance committee approval in June, and onboarding for up to fifteen users. Action items were assigned to revise the schedule and confirm personnel allocation.
output_text: In the kickoff meeting for Northwind Logistics, it was decided to implement a three-phase rollout starting with a discovery phase in April, followed by a pilot at the Hai Phong depot in early May, with a decision gate prior to broader deployment. Action items were assigned to revise the schedule and confirm personnel allocation.
